title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
**BITCOIN MIDDAY BRIEF**

Bitcoin's up 2.5% to $61,634—solid momentum in the US morning. But here's what matters: we're still trading in extreme fear territory, Fear & Greed sitting at just 19. That's capitulation-level psychology, which historically precedes rallies.

Network health is solid. Hashrate holding steady at 954.3 exahashes, meaning miners aren't panicking despite price volatility. Mempool's clean at 108K transactions—no congestion stress.
